editing.software: FFmpeg 8.0.1; Playwright/Chrome capture and local editorial overlays
editing.overlays: Editorial titles/captions only. Portal account/creator columns and private headers are excluded by documented crops.
editing.timing: Normal-speed original video intervals, followed by a hold of the same capture's original result screenshot. No response text is synthesized; screenshot paths/hashes and hold durations are listed.
editing.cli_capture_type: Real subprocess output in a headless-browser panel, not native macOS Terminal video.

scope_and_limits: All selected footage belongs to the fresh rg-mflabs15-jw-0928 run. Old NC and Sweden footage/results remain archived.
Portal recording used the existing authorized browser session in memory. No authentication-state file was exported; temporary recording contexts were closed.
The first-model portal scene is an actual new request without Web search. Other portal scenes and review-* sources read existing results only.
The Korean main guide was run; English File Search, the managed target and both language CI releases are separately identified. Bilingual captions are not two complete language reruns.
Managed Task Adherence returned six rows, five pass and one fail. Row 6 severity 0 contradicts native failure/attack-success flags; original flags and service-redacted inputs remain unchanged.
Native inconsistency holds final acceptance. No new holdout was unlocked, no corrected ASR or production safety certification is claimed.
Optimizer succeeded with an audited six-row baseline at 1.0 and no new full candidate. No improvement or promotion is claimed.
Hosted IQ versions 1/2 and CI local-retrieval versions 1/2 are distinct targets. Basic RAI attachment does not prove a platform block.
The original account-API 401, A2A propagation failure, setup errors and raw native audit remain preserved.
Old group absence and 13 idle owned sessions were verified. Retained Search, files/volumes and logs can continue to incur costs.
